description: Hand the traveller to Tell & Go's own checkout on tellandgo.com for the quoted rate. Returns checkout_url: the traveller opens it, enters guest details and pays there. This tool asks for no personal or payment card data, and creates no booking: the booking exists only after the traveller pays, and Tell & Go then emails the confirmation. Call get_quote, then this tool with the quote_id and residency. Relay total and price_changed from the result. If the total exceeds a budget the user stated, do NOT call this yet: tell them the price, say it exceeds their budget, and get explicit confirmation first.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

quote_id.description: quote_id used for prebook_stay; must match exactly.

name: start_booking

outputSchema.description: A tellandgo.com checkout hand-off (booking_id null until the traveller pays), or a pending booking when hosted Stripe Checkout is in use, plus the checkout link the human must open to pay.

amenity_disclosure.description: Present when sold on the amenity waiver; relay its note.

cancellation.description: Where cancellation is handled (emailed secure link).

checkout_host.description: Host of checkout_url; tellandgo.com when the booking is completed on Tell & Go's own checkout.

checkout_url.description: Checkout URL for the human traveller: tellandgo.com checkout (see checkout_host) or hosted Stripe Checkout.

degraded.description: True when only a minimal summary could be rendered; do not retry start_booking.

handoff.description: site_checkout (tellandgo.com checkout for the agreed rate) or property_page (pick the rate on tellandgo.com); absent for hosted Stripe Checkout.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call.

lineage.description: quote_id, prebook_id and payment identifiers for cross-checking.

price_changed.description: True when total differs from the quote. Tell the traveller the new total.

quoted_total.description: The total from the quote this handoff started from.

residency.description: Residency the booking was priced for.

title: Continue to Tell & Go checkout (tellandgo.com)
